Let me think about the architecture for this adapter system carefully...

Here is the adapter interface and registry implementation:

export interface Adapter {
  id: string;
  name: string;
  detect(url: URL): boolean;
  extract(doc: Document): Promise<Result>;
}

export class AdapterRegistry {
  private adapters: Map<string, Adapter> = new Map();

  register(adapter: Adapter): void {
    this.adapters.set(adapter.id, adapter);
  }

  getAdapter(id: string): Adapter | undefined {
    return this.adapters.get(id);
  }
}

Now add artifact support for code generation.

Here is a code generator artifact that uses template resolution:

CodeGenerator
export class CodeGenerator {
  generate(template: string): string {
    return template.replace(/\{\{(\w+)\}\}/g, (_, key) => this.resolve(key));
  }

  private resolve(key: string): string {
    return key.toUpperCase();
  }
}
